description_en: Creates department information based on the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID and department name. Upon successful creation, the department ID is returned
description_zh: 根据AICCS实例ID、部门名称创建部门信息，创建成功后会返回部门ID
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs create-department --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --department-name '部门A' --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDepartment

parameters.help_en:
Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID.  
You can obtain it from **Instance Management** in the left-side navigation pane of the [Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在[智能联络中心控制台](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id
